target_node_version_note: read from adapter.create() of the target environment
node_version_note: Source and target deliberately run on different Node versions: the E2B default template is fixed to v20.x and cannot be changed without a custom template, the source follows the devcontainer image. node_version_aligned compares process.version with target_node_version by major version, once both are known. See README, section "Limits of the measurement".
target_tooling_note: unzip and node as resolved inside the target on the first adapter.create(). Evidence that the image brought them: installing a missing tool per run would land inside a measured phase.
e2b_region_note: not determinable: SandboxInfo from the e2b SDK (as of e2b@2.38.3) contains no region field
browser: Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) HeadlessChrome/151.0.0.0 Safari/537.36
browser_note: taken from the X-User-Agent header of the first POST /run
clock_note: populated after the first successful run. The interruption time is measured across two clocks: the stop timestamp comes from the browser, the first tick timestamp from the target. target_clock_offset_ms is estimated with Cristian's algorithm (5 samples of `date +%s%N`, the sample with the smallest round trip wins). The uncertainty of a converted timestamp is at most half the round trip plus 1 ms resolution (Cristian 1989). client_clock_skew_ms is the browser clock against the runner clock, measured when the request headers arrive; both run on the same host, the value documents that instead of assuming it. Per-run values are in results.csv.
